# 2 Chronicles Chapter 3 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-he-began Solomon to-build house-of YHWH in-Jerusalem on-Mount the-Moriah where He-appeared to-David his-father in-the-place that prepared David in-threshing-floor-of Ornan the-Jebusite.

**2** And-he-began to-build in-the-second in-the-month the-second in-year four-of his-reign.

**3** And-these are-the-foundations-of Solomon for-building house-of God the-length in-cubits by-the-measure the-first cubits sixty and-the-width cubits twenty.

**4** And-the-porch that was-on the-face-of the-length on the-face-of the-width-of the-house cubits twenty and-the-height a-hundred-and-twenty and-he-overlaid-it from-within gold pure.

**5** And the-great house he-paneled with-wood-of cypress and-he-overlaid-it with-gold fine and-he-put upon-it palm-trees and-chains.

**6** And-he-overlaid the-house with-stones-of precious for-beauty and-the-gold was-gold-of Parvaim.

**7** And-he-overlaid the-house the-beams the-thresholds and-its-walls and-its-doors with-gold and-he-engraved cherubim on the-walls.

**8** And-he-made house-of the-holy-of-holies its-length on the-face-of the-width-of the-house cubits twenty and-its-width cubits twenty and-he-overlaid-it with-gold fine to-talents six-hundred.

**9** And-the-weight of-the-nails to-shekels fifty gold and-the-upper-rooms he-overlaid with-gold.

**10** And-he-made in-house-of the-holy-of-holies two cherubim work-of sculpture and-he-overlaid them with-gold.

**11** And-wings-of the-cherubim their-length cubits twenty wing-of the-one cubits five reaching to-wall-of the-house and-the-wing the-other cubits five reaching to-wing-of the-cherub the-other.

**12** And-wing-of the-cherub the-one cubits five reaching to-wall-of the-house and-the-wing the-other cubits five joining to-wing-of the-cherub the-other.

**13** Wings-of the-cherubim these spreading cubits twenty and-they standing on their-feet and-their-faces toward the-house.

**14** And-he-made the-curtain of-blue and-purple and-crimson and-fine-linen and-he-put upon-it cherubim.

**15** And-he-made before the-house pillars two cubits thirty-and-five height and-the-capital that was-on its-top cubits five.

**16** And-he-made chains in-the-inner-sanctuary and-he-put on-top-of the-pillars and-he-made pomegranates a-hundred and-he-put on-the-chains.

**17** And-he-set-up the-pillars on the-face-of the-temple one from-the-right and-one from-the-left and-he-called name-of the-right-one Jachin and-name-of the-left-one Boaz.


---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **3:1**: Mount the-Moriah — Only Chronicles connects the temple site to Mount Moriah, linking Solomon's temple to Abraham's near-sacrifice of Isaac (Genesis 22:2).

- **3:4**: height a-hundred-and-twenty — This extraordinary height has puzzled scholars. Some suggest textual corruption; others see deliberate theological symbolism.

- **3:17**: Jachin and-Boaz — The pillar names likely mean 'He establishes' and 'In Him is strength.' They stand as theological sentinels at the temple entrance.


— EMET
